## Global options

Accepted by `vantage` itself and by every command, before or after the command name (`vantage --tier STANDARD run …` equals `vantage run --tier STANDARD …`). `--tui` and `--version` are accepted on the root command only.

| Option | Type | Sets | Env | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | text | — | `VANTAGE_CONFIG` | Config file to merge over the shipped defaults (default ~/.config/vantage/default.json; env VANTAGE_CONFIG). |
| `--backend`, `-b` | choice[workflow\|api\|agent-sdk\|langgraph\|adk\|crewai] | `engine.backend` | — | Execution backend (engine.backend). |
| `--tier`, `-t` | choice[EXECUTIVE\|STANDARD\|FULL_ANNEX] | `engine.tier` | — | Output tier (engine.tier). |
| `--auth`, `-a` | choice[subscription\|api-key] | `auth.mode` | — | subscription (default: runs on your Claude plan, reads no API key) \| api-key (billed per token, explicit opt-in). |
| `--output-dir` | text | `engine.output_dir` | — | Run tree root (engine.output_dir). |
| `--max-concurrency` | int range | `engine.max_concurrency` | — | Concurrent agents (engine.max_concurrency). |
| `--set` | list[text] | — | — | Set any config key: dotted.key=value (value JSON-parsed; repeatable). |
| `--role-model` | list[text] | `role_model_map.<agent>` | — | Route an agent to a model tier: agent=tier (synthesis\|research\|cheap; repeatable). |
| `--icons` | choice[nerd\|unicode\|ascii] | `ui.icons` | — | Icon set: nerd (Nerd Font, default) \| unicode \| ascii. |
| `--ascii` | flag | `ui.icons` | — | 7-bit output (= --icons ascii). |
| `--no-color` | flag | `ui.color` | — | Disable colour (also honours NO_COLOR). |
| `--theme` | choice[dark\|light] | `ui.theme` | — | Colour theme: dark \| light. |
| `--no-animations` | flag | `ui.animations` | — | No spinners or live redraws. |
| `--quiet`, `-q` | flag | — | — | Only warnings, errors and the final result. |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag | — | — | Extra detail (tool calls, resolved paths). |
| `--tui` | flag | — | — | Launch the Ink TUI, forwarding the remaining arguments (root only). |
| `--version` | flag | — | — | Print the version and exit (root only). |

## vantage run

Run a dossier end to end with the selected backend.

```text
vantage run [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--client`, `-c` | text | required | Client legal name |
| `--slug`, `-s` | text | — | Run directory name (default: from the client name + YYYY-MM) |
| `--as-of` | text | — | YYYY-MM-DD (default: today) |
| `--common-name` | text | — | Name the client is known by |
| `--ticker` | text | — | Ticker, or PRIVATE (default run_defaults.ticker_or_private) |
| `--vertical` | text | — | Target vertical (default run_defaults.target_vertical) |
| `--geography` | text | — | Primary geography (default run_defaults.primary_geography) |
| `--account-context` | text | — | — |
| `--relationship` | text | — | Known relationship context |
| `--objectives` | text | — | Strategic pursuit objectives |
| `--capability-pack` | text | — | ATTACHED\|NOT_ATTACHED. Without it every organization capability claim renders [INTERNAL: validate with practice]. |
| `--input-sheet` | text | — | ATTACHED\|NOT_ATTACHED (§21.10). Without it win probability, account revenue, relationship strength, and stakeholder access render [INTERNAL REQUIRED]. |
| `--remediation-rounds` | int 0–2 | — | Owner-remediation rounds after verification (P7R), 0-2; default 1. Workflow backend. |
| `--ask-key` | flag | off | With --auth api-key: prompt on this terminal for any key that is not already in the environment. The key is never stored. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | off | Print the resolved job and config as JSON; run nothing. |
| `--json` | flag | off | Stream RunEvent JSON to stdout (for the TUI) |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options) and every [config flag](#config-flags).

## vantage export

Export a dossier to PPTX, DOCX, PDF and/or self-contained HTML.

```text
vantage export [OPTIONS] TARGET
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TARGET` | text | required | A \*-vantage.md dossier, a run directory, or a run slug under the output dir. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format`, `-f` | `pptx\|docx\|pdf\|html` (repeatable) | — | Output format; repeat for several (pdf implies docx). Default: export.formats. |
| `--depth` | `exec\|standard\|full` | — | exec ≈ 18 slides · standard ≈ 31 · full = every section. |
| `--site-mode` | `microsite\|deck` | — | Shape of the HTML output. |
| `--authoring` | `deterministic\|agents` | — | deterministic maps sections to plans; agents lets Claude author them. |
| `--out`, `-o` | path | — | Output dir (default &lt;run dir&gt;/exports). |
| `--classification` | text | — | Marking on every page, slide and screen. |
| `--brand` | text | — | Domain whose brand themes the collateral (via get-brand). |
| `--client-logo`, `--no-client-logo` | flag | — | Client logo on the cover. |
| `--open` | flag | off | Open the output folder when done. |
| `--json` | flag | off | Stream RunEvent JSON to stdout, then {"result": …}. |

**Export helpers**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--helper-icons`, `--no-helper-icons` | flag | — | get-icon glyphs. |
| `--helper-brand`, `--no-helper-brand` | flag | — | get-brand theming. |
| `--stock-images`, `--no-stock-images` | flag | — | get-stock splash images. |
| `--diagrams` | `auto\|dgm\|drawio\|mermaid\|none` | — | Diagram renderer. |
| `--illustrations` | `none\|napkin` | — | napkin spends Napkin credits (opt-in). |
| `--charts` | `matplotlib\|plotly` | — | Chart renderer. |
| `--libreoffice-bin` | text | — | LibreOffice binary for PDF conversion. |
| `--helper-timeout` | float ≥ 0.001 | — | Seconds before a helper call is abandoned. |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options) and every [config flag](#config-flags).

## vantage config migrate

Bring ~/.config/vantage/default.json up to the current schema.

Reconciles role_model_map against the live agent roster, and fills in keys the shipped template has gained. The previous file is kept alongside as `.bak`.

```text
vantage config migrate [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | off | Show what would change, write nothing |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options) and every [config flag](#config-flags).

|---|---|
| [`bash`](#vantage-completion-bash) | Print (or --install) the bash completion script. |
| [`zsh`](#vantage-completion-zsh) | Print (or --install) the zsh completion script. |
| [`fish`](#vantage-completion-fish) | Print (or --install) the fish completion script. |

## vantage completion bash

Print (or --install) the bash completion script.

```text
vantage completion bash [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--install` | flag | off | Write it to the user completion dir and say where. |
| `--prog-name` | text | `vantage` | vantage \| vantage-engine |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options) and every [config flag](#config-flags).

## Config flags

Every leaf of the configuration model is also a flag, accepted by every command, and hidden from `--help` to keep it readable (`vantage options` lists them; shell completion offers them). Booleans come as `--x/--no-x` pairs, list options are repeatable, and the literal value `null` clears an optional value. On the root command each flag also reads the first environment variable listed (lower precedence than the flag). `role_model_map` has its own `--role-model agent=tier`; `--set dotted.key=value` reaches any key, including ones without a flag.

| Flag | Key | Type | Shipped default | Env | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--engine-backend` | `engine.backend` | choice[workflow\|api\|agent-sdk\|langgraph\|adk\|crewai] | `"workflow"` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_BACKEND`, `VANTAGE_BACKEND` | Execution backend. workflow runs on the Claude subscription. |
| `--engine-available-backends` | `engine.available_backends` | list[str] | `["workflow", "api", "agent-sdk", "langgraph", "adk", "crewai"]` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_AVAILABLE_BACKENDS` | Backends offered by the TUI picker. |
| `--engine-tier` | `engine.tier` | choice[EXECUTIVE\|STANDARD\|FULL_ANNEX] | `"FULL_ANNEX"` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_TIER`, `VANTAGE_TIER` | Output tier per blueprint §4: EXECUTIVE \| STANDARD \| FULL_ANNEX. |
| `--engine-max-concurrency` | `engine.max_concurrency` | int | `10` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_MAX_CONCURRENCY` | Wave A launches ten concurrent research agents; anything lower serialises them. |
| `--engine-output-dir` | `engine.output_dir` | str | `"~/.cache/vantage/run"` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_OUTPUT_DIR`, `VANTAGE_OUTPUT_DIR` | Root of the run tree; each run is &lt;output_dir&gt;/&lt;slug&gt;. |
| `--engine-harness-dir` | `engine.harness_dir` | str\|null | `null` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_HARNESS_DIR`, `VANTAGE_HARNESS_DIR` | Prompt/blueprint library. null = the bundled harness. |
| `--engine-max-iterations` | `engine.max_iterations` | int | `24` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_MAX_ITERATIONS` | Maximum direct-API turns per agent. |
| `--engine-tool-result-max-chars` | `engine.tool_result_max_chars` | int | `24000` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_TOOL_RESULT_MAX_CHARS` | Truncate each tool result to this many characters. |
| `--engine-tool-timeout-seconds` | `engine.tool_timeout_seconds` | float | `120` | `VANTAGE_ENGINE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Seconds before one tool call is abandoned. |
| `--auth-mode` | `auth.mode` | choice[subscription\|api-key] | `"subscription"` | `VANTAGE_AUTH_MODE` | subscription (Claude plan, reads no key) \| api-key (billed per token). |

| `--export-classification` | `export.classification` | str | `"Confidential"` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_CLASSIFICATION` | Marking printed on every page, slide and screen. |
| `--export-brand` | `export.brand` | str\|null | `null` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_BRAND` | Domain of the organization whose brand themes the collateral (via get-brand). null = the neutral Vantage theme. |
| `--export-client-logo` / `--no-export-client-logo` | `export.client_logo` | bool | `true` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_CLIENT_LOGO` | Put the client's own logo on the cover (via get-brand). |
| `--export-helpers-icons` / `--no-export-helpers-icons` | `export.helpers.icons` | bool | `true` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_ICONS` | `get-icon` — icons for slide headers, KPI tiles and section dividers. |
| `--export-helpers-brand` / `--no-export-helpers-brand` | `export.helpers.brand` | bool | `true` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_BRAND` | `get-brand` — logo, palette and typography for `export.brand` and the client cover logo. |
| `--export-helpers-stock-images` / `--no-export-helpers-stock-images` | `export.helpers.stock_images` | bool | `true` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_STOCK_IMAGES` | `get-stock` — semantically matched splash images for covers and section openers. |
| `--export-helpers-diagrams` | `export.helpers.diagrams` | choice[auto\|dgm\|drawio\|mermaid\|none] | `"auto"` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_DIAGRAMS` | Diagram renderer for figure-spec blocks. `auto` picks dgm, then drawio, then Mermaid. |
| `--export-helpers-illustrations` | `export.helpers.illustrations` | choice[none\|napkin] | `"none"` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_ILLUSTRATIONS` | `napkin` concept illustrations. Spends Napkin credits, so it is opt-in. |
| `--export-helpers-charts` | `export.helpers.charts` | choice[matplotlib\|plotly] | `"matplotlib"` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_CHARTS` | Chart renderer for chart-spec blocks. |
| `--export-helpers-libreoffice-bin` | `export.helpers.libreoffice_bin` | str | `"soffice"` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_LIBREOFFICE_BIN` | LibreOffice binary used to convert the whitepaper to PDF. |
| `--export-helpers-timeout-seconds` | `export.helpers.timeout_seconds` | float | `60` | `VANTAGE_EXPORT_HELPERS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Seconds before any one helper call is abandoned. |
| `--ui-icons` | `ui.icons` | choice[nerd\|unicode\|ascii] | `"nerd"` | `VANTAGE_UI_ICONS` | `nerd` assumes a Nerd Font; `unicode` uses plain symbols; `ascii` is 7-bit only. |
| `--ui-color` | `ui.color` | choice[auto\|always\|never] | `"auto"` | `VANTAGE_UI_COLOR` | `auto` honours NO_COLOR and whether stdout is a TTY. |
| `--ui-theme` | `ui.theme` | choice[dark\|light] | `"dark"` | `VANTAGE_UI_THEME` | Colour theme for the CLI and TUI. |
| `--ui-animations` / `--no-ui-animations` | `ui.animations` | bool | `true` | `VANTAGE_UI_ANIMATIONS` | Spinners and live redraws. Off for screen readers and CI logs. |
